# ractermx_quota (Data Source)

Reads account quota information from RacterMX.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read account quota information to monitor resource usage.
data "ractermx_quota" "current" {}

output "domains_remaining" {
  value = data.ractermx_quota.current.domains_limit - data.ractermx_quota.current.domains_used
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `aliases_limit` (Number) Maximum number of aliases allowed.
- `aliases_used` (Number) Number of aliases currently in use.
- `domains_limit` (Number) Maximum number of domains allowed.
- `domains_used` (Number) Number of domains currently in use.
- `smtp_credentials_limit` (Number) Maximum number of SMTP credentials allowed.
- `smtp_credentials_used` (Number) Number of SMTP credentials currently in use.
